name: manager-plugin
description: living-plan: write a phased living plan and check it with a script. manager: run it to completion, one phase per PR, with fresh implementer and independent exact-SHA reviewer subagents, a braked fix loop, batched owner decisions and an opt-in record of what each run spent. create-vault: a project knowledge vault the implementers keep current. code-map: a generated code map and query, dependency-free, with pointers into a diff for reviewers, opt-in commit hooks that keep it current and a rules-file block that tells sessions to use it. self-training-skills: skills for recurring project work that improve from their own records, through reviewed PRs, with a check of their routing, lessons and trigger phrases and a query over their files. manager-retro: improve the skill from recorded runs, through a reviewed PR. Plus restricted worker, researcher and reviewer agents to delegate to instead of general-purpose, a lean fallback agent, a hook that steers subagent spawns away from general-purpose, the opt-in code-map commit check, a default-on map-first nudge before the first broad search in a mapped repository (and a skills-first one before the first search of skill files where there are self-training skills), a session-start hint when a repository's code-map rules block is older than the plugin's template, a guard that refuses whole-disk scans (find, ls -R, du, grep -r, rg, Get-ChildItem -Recurse on a filesystem, drive or home root), a start line giving every session and subagent the absolute code-map and skilltrain commands, and hooks that carry a manager run across a compaction and watch its orchestrator's context.
